searchText: Hello working on a project preparing a pitch for point of sale machines running nodes trying to figure out the tokenomics and get funded, am I in the right place? Is this what distributed validators could mean? I can understand the high level overview and business but not so much tech deep could this idea be of interest to decentralised networks? For anyone interested this is my presentation https://www.canva.com/design/DAFRSi88pU0/DrGz_x91OiB0CYC1MhvwGg/edit?utm_content=DAFRSi88pU0&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton I am sorry i just realised this is for devs but for decentralisation +1 or in general if you like this use case... let me know 🙂
